components.role: Main answer-routing head: in A attends to the question's relation word (recall), in B to the user's guess / chosen MC letter and copies it (strong copy head; Δguess +0.34, Δquestion -0.45)
Subject-recall head in A (0.75 on the question subject, e.g. ' Jupiter' when the guess was Saturn); in B diverted to the guess/BOS (Δquestion -0.56)
Global-attention guess-copy head in B (0.31 on guess vs 0.05 in A); strong copy OV circuit
Guess-copy head in B (0.29 vs 0.06), also attends to the chosen MC letter; its output subspace is read by the re-tuned L12-L14 MLPs
In A fetches the relation word (0.69) and, from the guess token, the question; in B attends to the 'I think the answer is' markers and '.', tagging/aggregating the guess
Final-layer guess-copy head in B (0.23 vs 0.03), writes the guess into the output
Late guess-copy head in B (0.23 vs 0.03)
Earliest (first global layer) head that in B attends from reply positions to the guess (0.29 vs 0.07); its output is what the re-tuned L5 MLP reads
Re-encodes the query/key features before the copy head: its weight change reads L9H0/L9H2 and writes into L10H2's Q/K subspaces (z +3.0); change is diffuse over units

First MLP to process the fetched answer: its input-weight change lies in L10H2's (and L10H0's) output subspace (0.47 vs 0.40 random); together with L11/L12 MLPs reading L11H2/L12H1 it passes the copied guess (B) or retrieved fact (A) to the logits

evidence: Attention tool: at the answer position A attends to question tokens (8.4) vs B (3.6) and B to the guess (3.8) vs A (2.0), consistent over 39 texts, prefixes and formats; no-guess controls identical; B copies the chosen MC letter and the wrong option in two-candidate questions while A attends to the correct candidate. Weights: diffs tiny and diffuse; copy-OV circuits of L10H2/L11H2/L12H1/L12H2 unchanged (<0.2%) so the change is in routing; token-level QK proxy unchanged, redirection built upstream; L9 MLP Δdown aligned with L10H2 Q/K subspaces (z+3.0), L10-L14 MLP Δ(gate,up) aligned with L10H2/L11H2/L12H1 output subspaces (z+2-3); attention divergence starts at L5 and peaks L9-L13.
